Subject:-
Proper handling of Legal Cases in field offices.- reg.
Reference:-This
office
Circular
No.
LC-9(12)2013/CPFC
Ref./Pt./3865
dated
16.05.2014
(available at sI. No. 118 at EPFOWebsite circualrs for 2014-15)
Sir,
Please refer to this office circular
reffered
above vide which
comprehensive
guidelines on handling of legal cases was issued.
4.
It is observed that inspite of detailed instructions
on handling of the Consumer
Forum Cases the field offices are not following
the directions
in
true spirit.
It is a
matter of serious concern. This leads to passing of adverse orders by District Forum
which are rarely reversed by Higher Courts and set a bad precedent for other cases
and have huge financial implication for the Fund. Again mostly these cases are related
to Pension Scheme and therefore
involve recurrent payment to pensioneers in view of
adverse orders.
5.
Therefore
there
is urgent
requirement
to focus
attention
on the
Consumer
Forum cases.
Zonal ACCs and RPFC/OICs must review the status of Consumer Forum
cases personally
at least once a month.
It should be ensured that
proper written
statement
is filed in each case explaining the relevant provision of Act and Scheme.
The Focum should also be apprised of the mandate of the Act and be requested to
pass orders as per prescribed provisions.

- 4.
Therefore,
it is once again reiterated
that
the above circular
should
scrupulously
be followed
by the field functionaries
for meticulous
handling
of all legal cases in their
jurisdiction.
Yours faithfully
(M P V
rghese)
Additional
Central
P. F. Commissioner
(Legal)
